ios.desc:
Relax and unwind with Fruit Fall: Match Fruit Puzzle, a casual puzzle game where you drop, match & blast falling fruits to create bigger, juicier combos.
Inspired by classic drop-and-merge gameplay, every move challenges your logic while keeping the experience calm, colorful, and stress-free.

How to Play:
1) Drop fruits and merge matching ones to create larger fruits
2) Plan each move to avoid filling the board
3) Use special boosters to clear space and extend your run

Game Features:
- Classic drop-and-merge fruit puzzle with simple mechanics & deep strategy
- Easy to learn casual brain puzzle
- Relaxing gameplay
- Score Challenges to keep the game interesting
- Bright visuals & smooth animations with vibrant fruit designs

Perfect for players who love casual puzzle games with relaxing brain challenges. The drop & merge mechanics of the game make it stress free for you to relax and enjoy in your free time.
